"Which automation platform should we use: Zapier, Make, or n8n?"

It is one of the most common questions we hear from founders and operations leads.

The answer depends on three things: volume, complexity, and data privacy.

Zapier is the fastest to set up and connects to almost everything, but costs scale quickly as task counts rise. Make offers a visual builder for intricate logic and multi-branch workflows at a more predictable price point. n8n gives you complete control through self-hosting, which is ideal if you process sensitive data or millions of tasks.

Don't pick the trendiest tool. Pick the one that matches your data volume and internal technical capacity.
